体入時給pay-val{font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:900}.pay-box.trial .pay-val{color:var(--pink)} .side-sticky{position:sticky;top:80px} .apply-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink-l),#fce4ec);border-radius:16px;padding:20px;border:1px solid var(--pink-m);text-align:center} .apply-card h3{font-weight:900;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:.95rem} .btn-apply-big{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink),var(--pink-d));color:#fff;font-weight:700;border-radius:100px;padding:14px;font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:10px;width:100%} .apply-note{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.7} .warning{background:#fffbeb;border:1px solid #fde68a;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:.78rem;color:#92400e;margin-top:16px;line-height:1.8} .summary{font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.9;color:#374151} .mobile-cta{display:none;position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:199;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:10px 12px} .mobile-cta a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink),var(--pink-d));color:#fff;font-weight:700;border-radius:100px;padding:12px;font-size:.9rem;width:100%} .footer{background:#111;color:#fff;padding:24px 16px;margin-top:32px;text-align:center;font-size:.78rem} .footer a{color:#f9a8d4;margin:0 6px} @media(max-width:700px){.grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}.side-sticky{position:static}.mobile-cta{display:block}}

体入時給pay-val{font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:900}.pay-box.trial .pay-val{color:var(--pink)} .side-sticky{position:sticky;top:80px} .apply-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink-l),#fce4ec);border-radius:16px;padding:20px;border:1px solid var(--pink-m);text-align:center} .apply-card h3{font-weight:900;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:.95rem} .btn-apply-big{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink),var(--pink-d));color:#fff;font-weight:700;border-radius:100px;padding:14px;font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:10px;width:100%} .btn-apply-big:hover{opacity:.9} .apply-note{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.7} .warning{background:#fffbeb;border:1px solid #fde68a;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:.78rem;color:#92400e;margin-top:16px;line-height:1.8} .summary{font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.9;color:#374151} .mobile-cta{display:none;position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:199;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:10px 12px} .mobile-cta a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink),var(--pink-d));color:#fff;font-weight:700;border-radius:100px;padding:12px;font-size:.9rem;width:100%} .footer{background:#111;color:#fff;padding:24px 16px;margin-top:32px;text-align:center;font-size:.78rem} .footer a{color:#f9a8d4;margin:0 6px} @media(max-width:700px){.grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}.side-sticky{position:static}.mobile-cta{display:block}}
